Title: Foreshadowing Destruction IS usable at DOM vs 10+ pool

Messages.Author: brandonsantacruz
Messages.Body:
One thing that came up in a past tournament came up again in our draft. I looked up the answer and thought I would share it.

Foreshadowing Destruction may NOT be played at DOM against a target with 10+ pool. (incorrect, see below)

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
Klaital is correct. Foreshadowing is playable anytime between announcement and resolution, unless something doesn't allow its play.

LSJ was answering about the timing window.

Here's a ruling that (amongst others) shows Foreshadowing Destruction is played before resolution:  [LSJ 20080105] .

>
> Thank you for the clarification!

It does trigger it (when FD is played), and the previously played Conditioning's "you can't play another action modifier to further increase the bleed" is also triggered (when Conditioning is played).
If you play sup' FD against someone on 10, you can't play Conditioning afterwards.

However, since sup' FD doesn't increase the bleed, Conditioning's restriction doesn't bar from playing it.

Messages.Author: brandonsantacruz
Messages.Body:
Ok, so you could play it like this (assuming your target has 10+ pool):

Govern + Conditioning (lets say at DOM) + Foreshadowing Destruction + stealth (or at least dig for it and hope you get it)

but not

Govern + Foreshadowing Destruction + Conditioning (FD restricts playing another bleed increasing action modifier even though it was not one in the first place)

In case one from above, if I am deflected to someone with less than 10 pool, am I bleeding them for 9 pool?
